name: Unity is Luxury
description:
All are equal before the flames of war. Do not entrust all your hope to others and lose sight of your own strength.
Allies have greatly reduced cost limit.

abilities.text: Once their identity is confirmed, restores your max DP after retreating to the Objective Point
When their identity is revealed, the next attack's ATK is greatly increased
When their identity is revealed, becomes <$ba.invisible>Invisible</>
Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.
